hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog 234649 (7 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites with Electricity Hookup 30: 10E, 16E, 17E, 18E reservable, 13-15 first-come; no water or sewer hookup listed) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/mavreeso-campground ('5 sites with electrical hookups'; 'Electric Site Charge: $11 per night'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 18 family sites in loops A and B plus one group site (tents only, no RVs or trailers). Forest Service: 'Max RV size = 35 ft'; every wheeled vehicle must fit on the spur and there is no overflow parking. Most sites level, many pull-throughs. Up to 8 people per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/mavreeso-campground ('19 beautifully situated campsites'; 'There are pull-throughs for RVs'; 'Max RV size = 35 ft'; 'Equipment with wheels (RVs, campers, cars) must fit in the parking spur. There is not any overflow parking available.'; 'No RV or trailers allowed at the group campsite'; 'Maximum number of people per site: 8') + recreation.gov catalog 234649 (18 STANDARD + 1 GROUP; 15 pull-throughs), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Water in season only (none during the late-2026 extension).

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234649 ('vault toilets and drinking water'; amenities 'Vault Toilets', 'Water Spigot') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/mavreeso-campground ('Potable water is available at this site'; Current Conditions 'No water available' for the end-of-September to Nov 22 extension), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Forest Service: 'May through September'; dates are recreation.gov's fee season (the same May 8 - Sept 26 every year 2026-2028). In 2026 it stayed open from the end of September to Nov 22 with limited services and no water.

values.note: 12 sites reservable (incl. the group site and four electric sites), 7 first-come (11-15, B08, B09). Book at least 4 days ahead. 14 nights in any rolling 30 days. If a site is empty, campers may come in before check-in time.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/mavreeso-campground ('There are 12 reservable sites'; 'If the site is empty, campers may come in anytime') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234649 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 per rolling 30 days, reservationCutOff 4) + catalog 234649 (reservable flags) + /rates (Peak Season 05-08 to 09-26), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $32 a site, $43 with electric ($11 electric charge); group site $115 (2026-2028).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234649/rates (2026-2028 Peak: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 32, STANDARD ELECTRIC 43, GROUP 115) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/mavreeso-campground ('Single Site Non-Electric: $32 per night'; 'Electric Site Charge: $11 per night'; 'Group Site: $115'), read 2026-10-28

note: San Juan NF, along the West Dolores River off West Dolores Road (FR 535, gravel) about 6 mi from CO-145 and ~19 mi NE of Dolores, at ~7,600 ft under spruce, pine and fir. Fishermen's parking nearby; private land along parts of the river. The last 6 mi of FR 535 north toward Rico are steep, narrow and not recommended for trailers, so come in from the south end. Generators no more than an hour at a time. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov + catalog: confirmed electric 30, vault toilets, water, pull-throughs, part reservable on recreation.gov, $32-43 (2026); added 19 sites, max RV 35 ft (FS), season 05-08 to 09-26 (rec.gov fee season, FS 'May through September'), booking cutoff/14-night limit/booking.season. flags: Missing phone: Dolores Ranger District (970) 882-7296 (FS page; also the number the road table gives). recreation.gov gives the concessionaire's line (661) 702-1420 (goexplorus.com).

Electric count: FS says 5 sites with electrical hookups; the catalog lists 7 (10E, 16E, 17E, 18E reservable; 13, 14, 15 first-come), all 30 A on public sites. Stored sewer false left alone (no source lists a sewer hookup).
Length conflict: FS 'Max RV size = 35 ft' vs catalog 30-60 ft (ten sites at 60, a likely placeholder). Recorded 35.
Group-site size: FS 'up to 18 people'; recreation.gov 'up to 40 people'.

Road (post-flood): Dolores RD road table as of 10/26/2026 lists 'West Dolores / Meadows* 535 Open, No gate; weather dependent', with the asterisk 'These roads do not have a gate therefore are not regularly monitored. Please call (970) 882-7296'. The Oct 22-25, 2026 flood damage listed for the district is on other roads (Ryman Creek 240 north end washed out). Not verified on the ground.
Status: FS 'Site Open' - 'Campground open from end of September through November 22nd, 2026 with limited services. No water available.'

Waterfront (stored riverfront): the water is real but the vocabulary is the question. On imagery the West Dolores here is a small mountain river, roughly 10-15 m wide (mostly in tree shadow), well under ~30 m, so creek vocabulary may fit better. Loop B sites 01-04 sit ~5-20 m above a bare gravel bank on the outside of the bend, open to the water; Loop A 16E-18E are near the channel on the west. FS: 'Many of the campsites are along the river'. Waterfront not changed.
Pin = FS coordinate (37.6512,-108.2968), 61 m from the catalog site centroid. OK. Elevation: stored 2,365 m (7,759 ft) vs recreation.gov 7,600 ft.
